title: Long-term follow-up of patients with adenocarcinoma of the Esophagus treated with perioperative chemotherapy (FLOT Protocol) or neoadjuvant chemoradiation (CROSS Protocol) (ESOFU Observational Study)
summary:
The previous ESOPEC study compared two different therapies for the surgical removal of tumours in oesophageal cancer. This study has already been completed and evaluated.
The long-term follow-up study ESOFU will examine over a period of several years whether chemotherapy before and after surgery prolongs survival time compared to radiotherapy and chemotherapy before surgery.

interventions.name: After inclusion in the study, the subjects will be contacted via telefphone once a year to assess overall survival and tumor progression. Annual follow-up visits are carried out until 7 years after the final follow-up of the last ESOPEC patient has been completed

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Participation in the ESOPEC trial
2. Ability to understand character and individual consequences of the
study
3. Written informed consent has been obtained
Exclusion criteria:
none
